# adraw

> Open-source drawing, diagramming, and agent-friendly canvas workflow tool.

## Core Documentation & Repository

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw): Official source code, issues, and architecture documentation.
- [README & Getting Started](https://github.com/adrawdev/adraw#readme): Installation, CLI/SDK usage, and agent integration guide.

## AI Agent & LLM Guidance

- Follows the standard /llms.txt specification for deterministic ingestion by coding assistants and RAG crawlers.
- Validated via [AccessGuard AI-Readiness Suite](https://ronanchnlps-bit.github.io/).
